Police officials transferred in Chhattisgarh and Rajasthan

In administrative reshuffling, Chhattisgarh has seen the transfer of 24 Indian Police Service (IPS) officers, including Superintendents of Police (SP) in 12 districts. Additionally, 13 Assistant Commandants were among those assigned new responsibilities within the Chhattisgarh police department. Rajasthan also conducted a significant administrative change, transferring 49 Additional Superintendents of Police (ASP) and appointing new officers to several districts.
